title: No spoilers of what comes later
statement: Nothing in a lesson may preview or point to what the student hasn't reached yet, though a teaser that gives away no events is allowed.
detail: The reading course's checklist has a blocking row against any text, feedback or check that previews content the student has not reached, hunted across every node type (`grade3-reading/artifacts/AlphaRead-QC-Checklist-v2-2026-09-04.md`, line 47). A content review of a reference lesson rejected an opening picture that gave away what would happen (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-aladdin-2026-08-25/feedback-text.txt`, line 6), and an external audit flagged a modelled inference that stated an event before the story reached it (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-inceptbench-2026-09-30/REGISTER.md`, line 85). A draft film plan keeps later events and the ending out of the opening film (`grade3-reading/artifacts/peter-pan-standing-2026-09-11/video-2026-09-16/PETER-PAN-PART-1-FILM.md`, line 79). The rule covers a lesson's text, feedback, checks, pictures and opening film.
against: none found; the same review allows a teaser, "no spoilers of events but teasers" (`grade3-reading/artifacts/feedback-aladdin-2026-08-25/feedback-text.txt`, line 4). The same build broke it on its first page: its first walkthrough answers a wrong tap on the first-read check with where that answer lives, "the river comes later, at the end of his wander…", and its table walkthrough of the same day still describes that reply as telling "where that answer actually lives". A later run found: A Grade 9 unit's opening film previews the ending on purpose, stating the killing as fact before any reading (`g9/sources/Othello Unit Video_ Info Sheet for Devfactory.md`). A later run found: A Grade 9 unit's reading texts feed forward before each section, and some feeds tell the learner what the section contains before it is read, which this rule forbids; the two courses' designs disagree (`g9/sources/Act 1 reading texts/Act 1/1. 1.1 - Iago_s Introduction - Text.docx`). A later run found: a Grade 9 unit film, played before the first reading, tells students on purpose where the story starts and where it ends, so every lesson reads as a step toward the ending (`othello-archive/sources/act1/Othello Unit Video - Info Sheet for Devfactory.txt`). A later run found: a Grade 9 unit-film brief deliberately tells the ending before the first reading, planting the destination and the start so that every lesson is read as a step on that journey (`g9/library/text/Lbde498.txt`). A later run found counter-evidence (`g9/script/v03/Othello-Unit-Video-Script-v3.txt`). A later run found counter-evidence (`g9/sources/Act 1 reading texts/Act 1/1. 1.1 - Iago_s Introduction - Text.docx`). A later run found counter-evidence (`othello-archive/sources/act1/Othello Unit Video - Info Sheet for Devfactory.txt`). A later run found counter-evidence (`g9/library/text/Lbde498.txt`). A later run found counter-evidence (`g9/film/TREATMENT.md`).
